decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already records the custom-fabricated stainless-steel spout exception and the affected component scope without leaving an obsolete off-the-shelf spout value.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures the accepted solenoid placement, button actuation, and pre-dispense isolation behavior from the supplied proposal.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records stainless steel as the custom spout material, so no additional or augmented Event is required.
Selecting render-style custom spouts does not alter the existing smooth-flow, consistency-preservation, or froth-preservation acceptance requirements.
The custom spout geometry decision does not change the existing no-drip, sealed-connection, or bowl-containment requirements.
The placard placement and customer-facing text are independently and fully represented by the existing same-message INTRODUCE Event.
Spout fabrication and render fidelity do not change the splash-control target for mixing operation.
The source decision concerns spout fabrication and orientation and does not alter bowl size, form, capacity, or selection priorities.
The custom spout choice must still satisfy the existing cleanability requirement, but the source does not select or change a cleaning method.
The source does not change whisk-head size, powder compatibility, bowl compatibility, or whisk style.
The component choice may later be reflected in the BOM artifact, but it does not change the current requirement to deliver a prototype bill of materials.
The request to match the rendering applies to the proposed spout design and does not modify the existing DJ-turntable visual theme.
